title: LabOps
content: My lab infrastructure, versioned from end to end. Terraform provisions Proxmox and Talos, Cluster API manages the workload cluster, and Argo CD deploys applications.
features: An explicit lifecycle: Terraform for the management cluster, Cluster API for workloads.
Applications synced from Git with Argo CD, Helm and Kustomize.
Prometheus and Grafana for observability, Bitwarden for secrets, and PostgreSQL backups on R2.
imageAlt: Conceptual LabOps platform illustration: Git and Argo CD deliver applications to a Kubernetes cluster on Terraform and Talos infrastructure, with observability.

caseStudy.problem: Rebuilding a lab means more than recreating virtual machines: cluster lifecycle, applications, secrets and persistent data need a clear order.
caseStudy.result: A documented rebuild path from the infrastructure base to a reconciled workload cluster, with explicit ownership and recovery steps.

title: Portal
content: A dashboard for my lab. Customisable widgets bring Kubernetes, Argo CD, Gatus, Prometheus and my reading feed into one workspace.
features: A single Go binary serving both the API and embedded React frontend.
Rearrangeable pages and widgets, a command palette and a kiosk mode.
Editing access protected by OpenID Connect with PKCE.
imageAlt: Portal dashboard showing the lab map, incidents and resource metrics in its original French interface.

caseStudy.problem: Cluster health, application delivery and service availability live in separate tools. I wanted one place to inspect my lab without losing that context.
caseStudy.result: A customisable workspace for cluster and application health, incidents and resources, with a versioned YAML layout and browser-based editing.

title: CVE-2025-1974
content: A minimal testing tool to investigate annotation injection in Kubernetes NGINX Ingress controllers and inspect controller logs.
features: An AdmissionReview request designed to test the injection path.
Controller log analysis to understand the observed behaviour.
imageAlt: Conceptual Kubernetes investigation illustration: a Python AdmissionReview request reaches NGINX Ingress, followed by controller log analysis.

caseStudy.problem: I wanted to examine how an NGINX Ingress controller handles a crafted AdmissionReview request and follow the behaviour in its logs.
caseStudy.result: A small Python test harness for focused reproduction and controller-log analysis, published with its source.
